Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 16 October 2026 16 October 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 11 August 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. Date of purchase: Number of Ordinary Shares purchased: Average price paid per Share (pence): Lowest price paid per Share (pence): Highest price paid per Share (pence): 12-Oct-2026 281,260 255.5470 254.2000 256.2000 13-Oct-2026 281,213 259.2559 258.0000 260.6000 14-Oct-2026 290,000 260.9867 259.6000 262.6000 15-Oct-2026 126,552 269.1921 268.2000 269.8000 16-Oct-2026 267,974 273.1086 270.8000 273.6000 Following the above transactions, the Company will have 960,484,654 Ordinary Shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 42,261,360 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 16 October 2026 is 960,484,654 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 11 August 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 13,810,895 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
